heading: Heading of the cover picker (a cover is a wide picture above a page's title).
upload: Big button in the picker that opens the file chooser.
hint: Under that button: files can also be dropped on it. {{size}} is the largest size in megabytes (MB).
uploading-progress: On the upload button while the picture uploads. {{progress}} is a percentage.
setting: On the upload button while the chosen picture becomes the cover.
from-space: Heading of the pictures already in this Space (product noun) to choose from.
use: Accessible name of a picture to choose. {{name}} is its file name.
none: When the Space has no pictures yet. Link cards are page blocks that show a web link.
advice: Tip at the bottom of the picker.
problems.type: Error for a file that isn't one of these picture formats.
problems.size: Error for a picture over the size limit. {{size}} is the limit in megabytes (MB).
errors.list: Error when the Space's pictures couldn't load.
errors.set: Error when the chosen picture couldn't become the cover.
